## 1. Artists list (`/artists`)

### 1.1 View toggle
Segmented control: Cards | Table. Saved per user (localStorage).

### 1.2 Filters
- Status (active / inactive / pending)
- Specialty (multi-select — from `artist_specialties` if exists, or hardcoded options)
- Location (multi-select if multi-location studio)

### 1.3 Card view
Grid 3-cols desktop, 2-cols tablet, 1-col mobile. Card:
- 200px portfolio thumbnail (first photo from artist_photos table, or placeholder)
- Avatar overlapping bottom-left of thumbnail
- Name + specialties chips (max 3)
- Stats row: appointments this month, revenue, commission rate
- "View profile" CTA

### 1.4 Table view
DataTable columns: Avatar+Name, Specialties (chips), Status, Appts/mo, Revenue/mo, Commission%, Actions.

## 2. Artist profile (`/artists/[id]`)

Quick actions: Edit, Send invite (if pending), View schedule, View commission rules.

### 2.2 Tabs
Overview / Portfolio / Schedule / Tax info / Commission rules.

### 2.3 Portfolio tab

### 2.4 Schedule preview
Read-only week view showing this artist's shifts. "Edit in Schedules" link.

### 2.5 Tax info
W-9 / 1099-K upload section. Status: Not submitted / Pending / Verified. Per Sprint 12 launch gate: ensure PII encryption.

### 2.6 Commission rules overrides
Per-artist override of studio default. Rule editor with preview calculator (Sprint 9 will deep-polish).

### 3.1 Layout
- Artists as rows, days as columns (7 cols for week)
- Time slots within each cell
- Toolbar: week picker, "Copy previous week", "Apply template", "Export PDF"

### 3.2 Drag assign
Drag shift block across cells to reassign. Optimistic via `useOptimisticToggle`.

### 3.3 Templates
Save current week as template with name. Apply template to current week (merge vs overwrite dialog). Defaults: "Standard 9-5 Mon-Fri", "Part-time Tue/Thu", "Weekend only".

### 3.4 Copy-paste week
Click "Copy previous week" → confirm → all shifts from prev week copy into current.

### 3.5 Time-off overlay
Different texture (diagonal stripes at 10% opacity). Tooltip on hover showing reason.

### 3.6 Mobile
Collapse to single-artist view with day dropdown. Swipe between days.

## 4. Time-off form (`components/schedule/TimeOffForm.tsx`)

- Calendar picker (date range)
- Reason dropdown: Vacation, Sick, Personal, Other (with text field)
- Approval flow: if requester is Owner/Admin, auto-approve. Otherwise status = pending until Owner approves.
- Conflict check: warn if overlapping existing appointments. Block submit if any already-booked.

## 5. Guest artists (`/guest-artists`)

### 5.1 List + detail
Similar structure to artists. Additional fields:
- Engagement start/end dates
- Host studio contact
- Revenue split %
- Portfolio / Instagram link

### 5.2 Sponsor/host flow
When adding a guest artist:
- Step 1: Engagement details (dates, revenue split)
- Step 2: Artist details (name, specialties, portfolio)
- Step 3: Access level (what can they see/do?)

## 6. Team invites (`/settings/team`)

### 6.1 Invite form
- Email + role picker + optional message
- Role picker shows permissions summary per role (tooltip)
- Invite link preview

### 6.2 Pending invites list
Table: Email, Role, Invited by, Invited at, Status, Actions (resend / revoke).

### 6.3 Accept flow (`/invite/[token]`)
- Branded landing
- "You've been invited to {studioName} as {role}"
- Sign up or sign in flow if not authenticated
- Accept → joins studio_members

## 7. Permissions matrix (`/settings/team/permissions`)

### 7.1 Visual grid
Rows: permissions (Create appointments, Edit clients, View financials, etc.). Cols: roles (Owner, Admin, Artist, Receptionist). Toggle per cell.

### 7.2 Role summary cards
4 cards above the grid, each summarizing what that role can do.

### 7.3 Custom roles (Pro plan)
If Pro+: "Add custom role" button. Copies from closest preset.

### 7.4 Reset to defaults
Per-role reset button with confirm.

## 8. Database
Verify `studio_members_permissions` table exists (from Sprint 6 migrations). If custom roles needed, add `custom_roles` table.

## 9. `/dev/design` updates
- Section 16: Team grid (artist cards)
- Section 17: Schedule grid isolated example

## 10. Acceptance criteria

```bash
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint --max-warnings=0 && pnpm build
```
Plus:
- Invite flow works end-to-end (send → receive email → accept → appears in list)
- Schedule grid handles 10 artists × 7 days smoothly
- Time-off conflict detection warns on overlap
- Permissions matrix toggle persists

Mechanical spec.

1	# InkOS — 12-Sprint Production-Grade UI/UX Hardening Program
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	InkOS has 73 authenticated pages, 13 public pages, 5 admin pages, 31 shadcn primitives, 255 domain components, and 200+ design tokens. Functionally complete, visually inconsistent. The audit surfaced 11 weakness areas: dark mode untested, loading states minimal (only 3 skeletons across 80+ components), error boundaries violate logger contract, mobile calendar broken, empty states ~50% covered, heading weight inconsistent, focus indicators unverified, color contrast unchecked in dark, no page transitions, calendar + consent builder desktop-only, no centralized Logo component.
6	
7	**Goal:** Ship a product that a customer would mistake for Linear, Stripe, or Attio. Every pixel intentional. Every state handled. Every breakpoint graceful. Every interaction < 200ms perceived. Zero console errors in production.
8	
9	**Execution model:** 12 sprints, each 6-10 autonomous hours. Total program: **95-115 hours** of agent work. Runnable in long blocks (5-10 hours per session) with agent coordination and explicit quality gates.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Competitive Benchmarks (the bar we're clearing)
14	
15	| Pattern | Primary benchmark | Secondary |
16	|---|---|---|
17	| Dashboard + KPI cards | **Linear** home, **Stripe** dashboard | Vercel, Cron |
18	| Calendar | **Cal.com**, **Fantastical** | Google Calendar |
19	| CRM / client profiles | **Attio**, **HubSpot** | Notion databases |
20	| Data tables + filters | **Linear** issues, **Attio** lists | Airtable |
21	| Command palette | **Raycast**, **Linear** cmd+k | Superhuman |
22	| Settings | **Stripe**, **Vercel** | Notion settings |
23	| Empty + loading states | **Linear**, **Height** | Notion |
24	| Motion / transitions | **Linear**, **Arc Browser** | Superhuman |
25	| Public booking (conversion) | **Cal.com** booking, **Calendly** | Stripe Checkout |
26	| Mobile treatment | **Stripe Dashboard mobile**, **Linear mobile** | Cron mobile |
27	
28	Rule: any pattern weaker than these three references gets redesigned.
29	
30	---
31	
32	## Agent Coordination Model
33	
34	Every sprint follows the **8-agent assembly line**:
35	
36	```
37	1. Nova     — 30-min competitor pass on the target area (screenshots, note patterns)
38	2. Vega     — Produce design spec (tokens, layouts, states, variants, motion)
39	3. Pixel    — For any public-facing page touched this sprint
40	4. Koda     — Build the spec (no design decisions — Vega's spec is law)
41	5. Dato     — Any schema/index/RLS needed for the feature
42	6. Luna     — Visual regression tests (Playwright) + component snapshot tests
43	7. Sage     — Code review gate (a11y, perf, types, security, design compliance)
44	8. Mira     — Capture lessons after each sprint → pattern library
45	```
46	
47	Rex orchestrates; Cadence watches agent performance; Witness classifies every run.
48	
49	**Quality gates** (every sprint must pass all):
50	- `pnpm typecheck` — 0 errors
51	- `pnpm lint --max-warnings=0` — 0 warnings
52	- Playwright visual regression — 0 unexplained diffs in light AND dark
53	- Lighthouse on every touched route — ≥ 90
54	- Axe a11y — 0 serious/critical violations
55	- Bundle size delta — ≤ +5% per sprint
56	- Sage approval — written ship/block verdict
57	
58	Any gate fails → sprint doesn't close → fixes continue until green.
59	
60	---
61	
62	## How to Run Continuously (5-10 hour sessions)
63	
64	**Session pattern:**
65	```
66	Hour 0–1   Nova competitor pass + Vega design spec (parallel)
67	Hour 1–5   Koda implementation (batched, parallel per page)
68	Hour 5–6   Dato + Luna (schema if needed, tests)
69	Hour 6–7   Sage review → fixes
70	Hour 7–8   Visual regression + Lighthouse + a11y gates
71	Hour 8–9   Mira extracts lessons, commits pushed per logical group
72	Hour 9–10  Verification on live Railway deploy
73	```
74	
75	Each sprint commits in 4-8 logical chunks. PR-sized commits, not one giant push. Rollback-safe.
76	
77	---
78	
79	## The 12 Sprints
80	
81	### PHASE A — FOUNDATION (Sprints 1–4)
82	*Lock the design DNA before touching feature pages. Everything downstream inherits from here.*
83	
84	---
85	
86	### Sprint 1 — Design System Foundation (8h)
87	
88	**Theme:** One source of truth for every visual decision.
89	
90	**Deliverables:**
91	1. **Token audit + dedupe.** `app/globals.css` has 200+ tokens — audit, group semantically, remove redundant ones. Produce `~/.claude/memory/projects/inkos-design-tokens.md`.
92	2. **Typography system.** Enforce scale via `<Typography>` component:
93	   - `display` (36/40 bold) / `h1` (28/32 bold) / `h2` (20/24 semibold) / `h3` (16/24 semibold) / `body` (14/20) / `caption` (12/16) / `micro` (10/14 uppercase tracking-wide)
94	   - Kill inconsistent `font-bold` vs `font-semibold` on h1/h2 (50+ instances found)
95	3. **Spacing rhythm.** Standardize on 4/8/12/16/20/24/32/48/64. Lint rule rejects raw `margin: 13px`.
96	4. **Icon size scale.** xs=12 / sm=14 / md=16 / lg=20 / xl=24 / 2xl=32. Every icon uses scale.
97	5. **Shadow + radius scale.** Shadows: `soft`, `card`, `card-hover`, `soft-md`, `lift`, `overlay`. Radii: `sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/full`.
98	6. **Missing primitives (build in `components/ui/`):**
99	   - `ComboBox`, `DateRangePicker`, `NumberInput`, `PhoneInput`, `MoneyInput`, `FileDropzone`, `FormField` (unified RHF wrapper)
100	7. **Missing shared components (`components/shared/`):**
101	   - `PageHeader`, `Section`, `KpiCard`, `StatCard`, `FilterBar`, `BulkActionBar`, `DataTable` (with column config + sorting + pagination), `FacetedFilter`, `EmptyState` (already exists — enrich variants), `PageError`
102	8. **Design showcase page** at `app/(app)/dev/design/page.tsx` (gated to `is_platform_admin`): every token, every primitive, every state rendered on one scrollable page. This is the human + agent reference.
103	
104	**Files:** `app/globals.css`, all `components/ui/*`, new `components/shared/*`, new `app/(app)/dev/design/page.tsx`
105	
106	**Agents:** Vega → Koda → Sage → Luna → Mira
107	
108	**Validation:**
109	- Every shadcn primitive visible on /dev/design
110	- `rg '#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}' app components` → only `#0a0a0f` + `#7c3aed`
111	- `rg 'shadow-(sm|md|lg|xl)[^-]' app components` → 0 hits
112	- Typecheck + lint clean
113	
114	---
115	
116	### Sprint 2 — Motion + Micro-interactions (8h)
117	
118	**Theme:** The product feels alive without feeling gimmicky. Linear/Stripe-grade.
119	
120	**Deliverables:**
121	1. **Motion tokens** (`lib/motion/tokens.ts`):
122	   - Durations: `instant=80`, `fast=120`, `base=200`, `slow=300`, `slower=500`
123	   - Easing: `standard=cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1)`, `emphasized=cubic-bezier(0.3,0,0,1)`, `decelerate=cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1)`, `accelerate=cubic-bezier(0.3,0,1,1)`
124	2. **Motion primitives** (`components/motion/`):
125	   - `<Fade>`, `<Slide>`, `<Stagger>`, `<PopIn>`, `<CountUp>`
126	   - Native CSS-only where possible (bundle-conscious)
127	3. **Skeleton system** (`components/skeletons/`):
128	   - `PageSkeleton`, `TableSkeleton` (configurable rows/cols), `ListSkeleton`, `CardSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton`, `ChartSkeleton`, `KpiRowSkeleton`, `SidebarSkeleton`, `DashboardSkeleton`, `ClientProfileSkeleton`, `AppointmentDetailSkeleton`, `CalendarSkeleton`
129	4. **Route-level `loading.tsx`** for heavy routes: `/calendar`, `/dashboard`, `/clients`, `/appointments`, `/reports/*`, `/payroll/*`
130	5. **Button loading state** — every button with an onClick that hits the network shows an inline spinner + "Saving…" / "Sending…" text. Audit every `<Button>` usage.
131	6. **Optimistic UI** — list mutations (delete, toggle, reorder) apply immediately, roll back on error with toast.
132	7. **Hover / press / focus rhythm** — 120ms hover, 80ms press, 200ms focus ring animation. Applied to Button, Card (hover lift), MenuItem, TableRow, NavItem.
133	
134	**Files:** new `lib/motion/*`, `components/motion/*`, `components/skeletons/*`, ~30 pages for `loading.tsx`, `components/ui/button.tsx` for loading prop
135	
136	**Agents:** Vega → Koda → Luna (motion snapshot tests) → Sage
137	
138	**Validation:**
139	- 0 layout shifts on navigation (CLS < 0.05)
140	- Every button click shows visual acknowledgment within 80ms
141	- Playwright records: every `loading.tsx` renders < 100ms, full page < 1s P95 on localhost
142	
143	---
144	
145	### Sprint 3 — State Completeness (loading / empty / error / success) (7h)
146	
147	**Theme:** Every screen handles every state. Zero orphan "No data" strings.
148	
149	**Deliverables:**
150	1. **Fix logger violation.** `app/(app)/error.tsx` + `app/admin/error.tsx` use `console.error` — replace with `import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'`.
151	2. **`<DataState>` wrapper** at `components/shared/DataState.tsx`. Accepts `{ data, isLoading, isError, isEmpty, children, loading, empty, error }`. Replaces ad-hoc `{data ? ... : 'No data'}` scattering.
152	3. **Polished empty states for every page.** Audit reveals ~50% coverage. Bring to 100%:
153	   - Artists, Guest Artists, Locations, Commission rules, Payroll runs, Consent templates (empty), Reports tabs (no data state), Marketing campaigns, Ink registry, Team invites, Waitlist, AI Design gallery, Client tabs (each: photos/files/notes/comms/financial)
154	4. **404 page** (`app/not-found.tsx`) — branded: illustration, search input, 3 most-visited links, return home.
155	5. **Route error boundaries** (`error.tsx`) for every route group: `(app)`, `admin`, `(auth)`, `book`, `consent`, `invite`, `ai-design/shared`. Each uses `<PageError>` shared component.
156	6. **Global error toast** on failed mutations — consistent copy, action button "Retry" where possible.
157	7. **Success feedback** — save actions show a subtle inline confirmation ("Saved · 2s ago") in addition to toast, like Notion.
158	
159	**Files:** `app/**/error.tsx`, `app/not-found.tsx`, `components/shared/DataState.tsx`, `components/shared/PageError.tsx`, ~40 pages for empty state integration
160	
161	**Agents:** Koda (states) → Vega (review visuals) → Quill (empty-state copy) → Sage → Luna
162	
163	**Validation:**
164	- `rg 'console\.(log|error|warn)' app components lib` → 0 hits
165	- Every route has a loading, empty, and error path (Luna runs grep + manual visit)
166	- No plain `'No data'` strings — all go through `<EmptyState>`
167	
168	---
169	
170	### Sprint 4 — Dark Mode Certification + Theme Toggle (9h)
171	
172	**Theme:** Every pixel verified in both modes. No broken contrast. No invisible text.
173	
174	**Deliverables:**
175	1. **Visual regression pass** — Playwright captures every page in both modes at 1440 and 375px. Diff report lists every contrast/layout issue.
176	2. **Fix contrast issues** — status badges, chart axes/labels, disabled inputs, focus rings, muted text, icons. Audit against WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text + UI).
177	3. **Theme toggle in header** — already in dropdown submenu; add an icon-only `<ThemeToggle>` to the header next to Cmd+K pill. Persists via `next-themes`.
178	4. **Chart theming.** Recharts config reads CSS tokens. Dark mode: lighter axis lines, brighter data colors. Light mode: subtle grid, muted axis. Unified `lib/charts/theme.ts`.
179	5. **Consent signing page** (always dark) — verify contrast (brand color on `--color-signing-bg`), ensure readable on projectors.
180	6. **Auth / booking pages** — currently hard-dark auth; either support both modes or justify staying dark (document).
181	7. **Dark mode E2E test** — Luna snapshot every page in both modes, lock regression.
182	8. **System preference + override** — default to system, explicit user choice persists.
183	
184	**Files:** `app/globals.css` dark block, every chart component (`components/reports/*`, `components/dashboard/*`, `components/payroll/*`, `components/commissions/*`), `components/shared/ThemeToggle.tsx`, `lib/charts/theme.ts`
185	
186	**Agents:** Vega (audit) → Koda (fix) → Sage (a11y contrast) → Luna (visual regression both modes)
187	
188	**Validation:**
189	- Axe contrast: 0 failures in either mode, on every page
190	- Playwright snapshots captured — both modes, 1440 + 375, committed to `tests/visual/`
191	- Theme toggle button present on header
192	
193	---
194	
195	### PHASE B — PAGES (Sprints 5–8)
196	*Page-by-page deep polish. Each sprint takes a high-traffic area to Linear/Stripe quality.*
197	
198	---
199	
200	### Sprint 5 — Dashboard + Calendar (10h)
201	
202	**Theme:** The two most-viewed pages. Where first impressions happen.
203	
204	**Deliverables — Dashboard (`/dashboard`):**
205	1. KPI row: Revenue MTD, Appointments today, New clients MTD, Pending deposits — each with sparkline (last 30 days) and % delta vs. previous period.
206	2. "Today's agenda" widget: next 3 appointments with client avatar + service + time, click → drawer.
207	3. Activity feed: recent bookings, consent signings, payments — live-updating.
208	4. Quick actions row: "New appointment", "Add client", "New consent request", "Invite artist" — keyboard shortcut hints.
209	5. Alerts card: overdue invoices, expiring consents, low-stock inks — actionable.
210	6. Empty state for brand new studios: "Your dashboard will fill up after your first booking".
211	
212	**Deliverables — Calendar (`/calendar`):**
213	1. Day / Week / Month toggle. Month = compact dots + count, Week = block view, Day = timeline.
214	2. Color per artist (from 10-color palette already in tokens).
215	3. Drag-to-reschedule with optimistic update + rollback.
216	4. Click empty slot → quick-add appointment modal.
217	5. Keyboard: `T` today, `[` `]` prev/next, `W/M/D` switch view, `N` new appointment.
218	6. Mobile: agenda view default, swipe between days, FAB for quick add.
219	7. Loading: `CalendarSkeleton` with time-axis scaffold.
220	8. Filters: by artist, by status, by service.
221	9. Print / iCal export.
222	
223	**Files:** `app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx`, `components/dashboard/*`, `app/(app)/calendar/page.tsx`, `components/calendar/*`
224	
225	**Agents:** Nova (Cal.com + Linear benchmark) → Vega (spec) → Koda → Dato (indexes for calendar query) → Luna → Sage
226	
227	**Validation:**
228	- Dashboard LCP < 2s on mid-tier mobile (simulated)
229	- Calendar renders 500 events without jank
230	- Mobile calendar works on 375px (agenda view)
231	
232	---
233	
234	### Sprint 6 — Client Management (10h)
235	
236	**Theme:** CRM-grade. Benchmark: Attio + Notion databases + HubSpot.
237	
238	**Deliverables:**
239	1. **Client list (`/clients`):**
240	   - Saved views (My clients, New this month, VIP, Inactive 90d) — user-editable filters persisted to a `client_views` table.
241	   - Faceted filter: tags, artist, service, last visit range, LTV range, source.
242	   - Bulk actions: tag, export CSV, send email, archive.
243	   - Column toggle + resize + sort.
244	   - Infinite scroll or paginated (200+ clients: paginated with "Load more"; URL-preserves page).
245	2. **Client profile hero (`/clients/[id]/overview`):**
246	   - Gradient cover with subtle studio branding.
247	   - Avatar + name + pronouns + pronunciation hint.
248	   - Chip row: LTV, total sessions, last visit, next booking, tags.
249	   - Quick action bar: Book appointment, Send consent, SMS, Email, Upload photo.
250	3. **Unified tab nav** across client detail: overview/appointments/photos/files/notes/consent/comms/financial. Tab underline + active state.
251	4. **Photo lightbox:** gestures (swipe on touch), keyboard (←/→/Esc), bulk download zip, artist tag, public share link (signed).
252	5. **Activity timeline (comms tab):** mixed feed of SMS, email, WhatsApp, appointment events, consent submissions. Filter by type.
253	6. **Notes:** rich text (use tiptap), @-mention artists, link to appointments. Auto-save on blur.
254	7. **Financial tab:** payments, deposits, refunds — each row linkable to the source appointment.
255	8. **Quick-add client** from Cmd+K.

271	
272	**Deliverables — Internal (`/appointments/*`):**
273	1. List with status pills (pending/confirmed/in-progress/completed/cancelled/no-show) — hover shows status history.
274	2. Filter chips: today, this week, artist, status, has-deposit.
275	3. Bulk reschedule + cancel with reason + client notification.
276	4. Appointment detail drawer (slide-in): client info sidebar, timeline (created → confirmed → deposit paid → completed), policies applied, deposit status, consent links.
277	5. New appointment: 3-step wizard with progress header (client → service → time) + summary sidebar. Autosave draft.

279	**Deliverables — Public (`/book/[slug]`):**

281	2. Artist picker: cards with portfolio thumbnail, specialties chips, "Book with" CTA.

285	6. Deposit collection step (Dodo Checkout) — clean, branded, on-brand colors.

292	
293	**Agents:** Nova (Cal.com + Calendly benchmark) → Pixel (public pages) → Vega → Koda → Quill (email/SMS) → Dato → Luna → Sage

296	- Public booking end-to-end on mobile 375px
297	- Conversion audit: 3-step flow, no dead ends, back buttons preserve state

302	### Sprint 8 — Artists / Team / Scheduling (8h)
303	
304	**Theme:** HR-grade team management. Benchmark: Rippling, Gusto, Linear team pages.
305	
306	**Deliverables:**
307	1. **Artists list (`/artists`):** card + grid view toggle, filter by status (active/inactive/pending)/specialty/location.
308	2. **Artist profile:** portfolio grid (lightbox reuse), stats (appointments this month, revenue, commission rate), schedule preview, tax info section, commission rule overrides.
309	3. **Schedule grid (`/artists/schedules`):**
310	   - Weekly grid (artists × days), drag to assign shifts.
311	   - Templates: "Standard work week", "Part-time Tue/Thu", "Weekend only" — save + apply.
312	   - Copy-paste week from previous.
313	   - Time-off overlay (different texture).
314	4. **Time-off form:** calendar picker, reason dropdown, approval flow if non-owner.

45	
46	  // Handle invite fetch errors
47	  if (inviteResult.status === 'rejected') {
48	    logger.error({ token: token.slice(0, 8) }, 'get_invite_by_token network error')
49	    return <InviteErrorState code="network_error" />
50	  }
51

54	  if (inviteError) {

57	    if (msg.includes('not_found') || msg.includes('not found')) {
58	      return <InviteErrorState code="invite_not_found" />

**Built from scratch:**
- `/artists/schedules` — replaces the current stub with a cross-artist grid: artists as sticky rows, Mon–Sun as columns, `ScheduleCell` handles slots + time-off diagonal-stripe overlay + add/remove interactions. - `TimeOffModal` adds an async conflict check (warns on overlapping confirmed bookings, does not block), and an auto-approve notice for owners vs. a pending-approval notice for artists.
- `InviteModal` gets an invite link preview row with a copy button, shown before the personal message.
- `TeamMembersTable` replaces plain-text role with the `chip-role-*` token classes already used everywhere else.
- `TeamInvitesTable` wraps resend in an `AlertDialog` confirmation.
